## Contract review

Head-sha: `f619d317d724cc8dae9f673353ca2ddafa7831da`
Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Local-runs: probe — the five scripts' own `--self-test` batteries on the head, two ablation legs of my own in a detached worktree at this head (each one `sed`, restored with `git checkout`, `git status --porcelain` empty), the previous records' reader probe (56 synthetic shapes plus the live PR #28023 and PR #27964 threads) and write-side refusal probe (31 shapes plus the 14 live fixture comments) re-run against worktrees at this head and at `origin/main`, a new probe of 78 shapes (19 fence closes, 11 heading indents, 42 writer key lines, 6 prose mentions) driven through `contractReviewHeadSha`, `recordKeyedLineRefusals` and the four readers on both trees, and a read-only corpus scan (11305 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23, 713 carrying the heading marker, driven through the reader and the writer's refusal on both trees) were executed locally, because the card's wanted items 1 to 3 are behavioural claims about the readers and the writer that no check-run prints and the PR body's own evidence is a head-versus-base comparison; the skill line ratchet, the skill-id lint, the token ratchet and `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28103` were run read-only beside them
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (:33) + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`FENCE_LINE` :12698, `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` :12699, the `contractReviewHeadSha` docblock :12702-12738 and body :12739-12760, H51 pins :33562-33567), scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (`RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` :2062-2066, `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE` :2067-2072, `headShaKeyLine` :2075, `recordKeyedLineRefusals` :2096-2106, pins :5329-5331), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`--template` note :1723-1727); read but not reviewed: check-half-states.mjs `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` :12631, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` :12681, `contractReviewHeadMatch` :12797, `latestContractReviewOnHead` :12815-12826, `contractReviewVerdictOf` :12853, record-recognisers.mjs `keyLineRegex` :534, `locateReviewOfRecord` :1991-2047, check-owed-reviews.mjs `recordReading` :196-216, check-governed-queue-guard.mjs `recordVerdict` :965, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs `MAX_LINE_BYTES` :2514.

### ① Derived judgments

Base is `origin/main`; the merge base is `549203d04`, which already carries PR #28042's merge commit `18318361f`, and `origin/main` has since moved to `59547058a` with no touch of the four changed files or the two consumer scripts (`git diff --stat 549203d04 origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch scripts/pm` is empty). The branch is the single commit `f619d317` (+56 / -25, 4 files). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28103` at the head: 1 of 4 paths hits the register (`.claude/**`), Tier S, 81 changed lines under the human-merge threshold; the three `scripts/pm/**` paths are off the register. The register, the PR body and the dev report agree. Each claim, judged by reading the code and by running it:

1. Fence close (card item 1, previous should-fix 6). `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` (:12699) is `FENCE_LINE` with `[ \t]*$` after the run; the walker now tests the close FIRST while a fence is open, so a line inside a fence is content unless it is a bare run of the open fence's character at least the opening length, and `FENCE_LINE` with its info string is consulted only outside a fence. Probed on both trees: three backticks then prose after an open fence leaves it open, so a `Head-sha:` line after it is fenced and the record names null where base named the cited head (F1), and the author's own plain line after a later bare run is read where base read the cited line (F2, F3, and the previous probe's trailing-text shape); a longer run with trailing text is content too (F11: null, base named the cited head). An info-string opener still opens (F4 `md`, F17 `~~~ js`, and a backtick inside the info string, F16, which CommonMark would not call a fence, still opens here in the fail-closed direction). A bare run with trailing spaces or a trailing tab still closes (F6, F7, F15), as does one indented up to three spaces (F13) and a longer bare run (F12); one indented four spaces does not (F14). CRLF bodies read the same as LF because the walker splits on `\r?\n` before the anchored test (F8, F9). TRUE.
2. Code-indented heading (card item 2, previous should-fix 7). The scope opens on `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER.test(line) && /^[ ]{0,3}#/.test(line)` (:12754); the second regex subsumes the blockquote refusal it replaces (a blockquote marker is not `#`) and refuses four spaces, a tab, two spaces then a tab, and a blockquote marker followed by four spaces (H1, H2, H6, H8: null; base read the line below). One to three spaces still open (H3 reads, as does the previous probe's one- and three-space shapes); a code-indented heading naming the cited head above the real heading is skipped and the author's line is read (H4: base read the cited head). The marker itself is byte-identical to base, so PRESENCE does not move anywhere: the locator, H43's filter, owed-reviews, the guard, `contractReviewVerdictOf`, the H64 adjacency pin and `recordKeyedLineRefusals` still see an indented-heading comment as a record, and the H51 pin (:33567) asserts exactly that (the marker finds it, `latestContractReviewOnHead` answers null). An indented-heading record therefore moves from `current` to `stale` in owed-reviews, never to `none`, and the writer refuses it before the write (W24). Intended, pinned, and the smaller of the two fixes the previous record named. TRUE.
3. Writer precision (card items 3 and 4, previous should-fixes 4 and 8). `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE` (:2072) is line-anchored with the `m` flag and tolerates any indent, repeated blockquote markers, a `-`/`*`/`+` bullet or a list number, and backticks or stars around the key, case-blind. Every reader-null-with-key shape the #28042 battery pins stays refused on this head: quoted, bulleted, fenced, pre-heading, code-indented (four spaces and a tab), the key folded into the span, bare hex, lowercase key, sub-floor span, a fully quoted record, a quoted heading over a plain line, a nested or unmatched fence, and the three new shapes (numbered, doubly quoted, `+`-bulleted, under a code-indented heading) (W16 to W29, W33, W36, W39, W41; the previous refusal probe's 31 shapes differ from base only in the two prose-mention rows). The two intended drops are measured: a non-record quoting a heading at line start and naming the key mid-sentence (P1) and a record-shaped prose mention (P2) are untouched on this head and refused on base; a record carrying its own plain line plus a prose mention below reads and passes on both (P6). The `why` text and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` now name the code-indented line and the line under a quoted or code-indented heading, and the printed text is pinned (:5331); each sentence is true against the reader. One imprecision: the spelling says the heading must be `unindented`, while the reader admits a heading indented one to three spaces (H3), which the same sentence grants the key line in words; cosmetic.
4. Shapes that DROP OUT of refusal under the new presence test while still reading null. Constructed and measured on both trees: a key line opening on a word before the key (`Current Head-sha:`, `Reviewed Head-sha:`, `head: Head-sha:`, W1, W13, W14), two keys on one line with the key second (`Served-tier: X · Head-sha: A`, W2), a table row (W3), underscore emphasis on the key (W4, W5), a task-list item (W6), a heading-styled key (W7), a unicode bullet or an emoji before the key (W8, W9), a bullet then a blockquote marker (W10), strikethrough (W11), parentheses (W12), a no-break space indent (W37) and a key inside an HTML comment (W42): 16 shapes, each refused on base and passing on this head, each reading null on both trees. The loss is loudness only: no reader on this head names a head on any of them (H43 null, locator absent, owed stale, guard absent, identical to base), so no wrong head is admitted and the queue still refuses; 0 of the 713 live heading-marker bodies carry a key anywhere without a key line, so no landed record is affected; and the new test matches the file's own `keyLineRegex` convention that already decides `Local-runs` presence in the same function, which is the shape the previous record's should-fix 4 asked for. Judged a should-fix, not a must-fix: a seat that copies the `--template` writes none of these, and the bound on the loss is the one the card accepted (no wrong head, triage 6522257381).
5. Monotone across the readers. My 78 shapes, the previous 56 and the 31 refusal shapes, on both trees: every reader change between base and this head is cited-head to null (F1, F11, H1, H2, H6, H7, H8, W24 and the previous probe's indented-heading shape) or cited-head to the author's own plain line (F2, F3, H4 and the previous probe's trailing-text shape); in no shape does this head name a sha that base did not read from a plain line below an unquoted, unindented heading. `latestContractReviewOnHead`, `locateReviewOfRecord`, owed `recordReading` and the guard's `recordVerdict` agree in every row on both trees, because all four reach the head through `contractReviewHeadMatch` and so through `contractReviewHeadSha` (the only call sites outside the self-tests are :12800, :12819, :12825, post-stamped.mjs :2100, record-recognisers.mjs :2013 and :2040; the guard and owed-reviews import the locator and spell no parser). Live threads: PR #28023 record 6518659368 at `40b5a25e` found / current / stands and absent at a wrong head; PR #27964 full thread found 6516322954 at `b3d92fee` and 6516042954 at `8216bec4`; the truncated thread null at `b3d92fee` and found at `8216bec4`. Identical to base and to the previous records.
6. Corpus. 11305 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23 (the previous review's REST snapshot, 713 heading-marker bodies; the dev's fresher 11482/724 snapshot is a superset): `contractReviewHeadSha` returns the same value on all 713 bodies on both trees (0 differences; the 2 nulls are the two no-key legacy records); `recordKeyedLineRefusals` returns the same rows on all 11305 comments on both trees (0 differences; the 1 refusal on each side is the pre-existing `Local-runs` row on record 6517315440); 711 records name a head and all 711 carry a `Reviewed-by:` line; 0 bodies carry a fence line with trailing text, a code-indented key line or a code-indented heading. The dev's 0 / 0 / 0 reproduces.
7. Self-tests on the committed head, exit captured: `check-half-states --self-test` 0, 5113 cases (dev 5113; base 5105, the H51 block gained two pins, each with four or five limbs); `record-recognisers --self-test` 0, 337 (unchanged: the template note is prose and gained no pin); `post-stamped --self-test` 0, 747 across 26 batteries (dev 747; base 744, three new pins); `check-owed-reviews --self-test` 0, 65 in 9 batteries; `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` 0, 403. All five match the dev's report.
8. Ablation, mine, in a detached worktree at this head: (A) the close test back to `FENCE_LINE` (one `sed`, `git diff --stat` 1 file +1/-1): half-states 1 of 5113 red (:33564, the trailing-text pin), post-stamped 0 of 747, recognisers 0 of 337; (C) `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE` back to `/head-sha[ \t`*]*:/i`: post-stamped 1 of 747 red (:5329, the mid-sentence pin). Each restored with `git checkout`, porcelain empty, HEAD still `f619d317`. Both match the dev's legs A and C; legs B and D are read from the report and are consistent with the pins at :33567, :5330 and :5331, not re-run.
9. contract-review.md :33. 「同形 = `## Contract review` 题头之下 `Head-sha:` 行独占码段、①②③逐项、独立性对、PASS/FAIL。」 True against the reader: the head is read from the first plain `Head-sha:` line BELOW the record's heading (:12752-12758), nowhere else. Line-neutral (60 lines on both trees, ceiling 60, headroom 0); the line is 120 bytes without its newline, equal to `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120 (base 117; the space dropped before 逐项 paid for 之下); no `#` followed by three or more digits in the file. `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` (164 cases) then the ratchet: exit 0, contract-review.md 60 of 60; `check-skill-id-lint.mjs --self-test` (23) then the lint: exit 0, 105 files clean; `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, 56 files within ceilings. The `--template` note (:1723-1727) says the line is plain and BELOW the heading and lists the quoted, bulleted, fenced, code-indented and pre-heading shapes as prose; true against the reader, and the printed template itself is unchanged.
10. Scope and metadata. The diff touches the four files the card names and nothing else; no export is renamed or removed (`FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` and `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE` are module-private; `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE`, `contractReviewHeadSha` and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` keep their names and shapes). PR body: `Fixes #28057` on its own line (the card closes on merge: all five wanted items landed), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; labels `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`. No new gate and no new refusal class: the reader's accept set is the same or narrower in every probed shape and the writer's refusal fires on a subset of what it fired on before.
11. Not measured here: ESLint on the touched scripts (no node_modules in the worktrees); the `Lint · ESLint` check-run on this head is success. The dev's 56 gate families are read from the report, not re-run; the `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` check-run on this head is success.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only); `skip-changeset` carried. `Clause-②: no` is right; no narrowing declared or present.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Served tier versus face: the register answers Tier S on the one `.claude/**` path, so the governed rules-text face applies and this record is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, the tier the queue guard reads. Triage 6522257381 graded p3, loudness, no wrong head admitted, no new gate; the diff adds no gate and no refusal class.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (attribution comment names os-elon-musk); no non-bot login to record.
- Contract-review-claim: comment 6523278850 names this seat session and this head; no competing claim, no hold, no hand-off; no reviews on the PR.
- CI at review time (third poll, 50 check runs on `f619d317`): 29 success, 20 skipped by path filter, 0 failure, 1 still in progress (Test Core 1/8). Success on Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI release & engine gates, the three Lint · scoped jobs, Type Check · workspace and its sub-jobs, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Test Core 2/8, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Live required-set sweep, Platform checklist gate sweep, Release section-coverage sweep, board snapshot, Auto Label, filter, Plan Test Core shards, Live half-state sweep. The final all-green reading is the landing gate's.
- Draft PR, `mergeable_state: blocked` (draft, runs in progress); Tier S landing by the owning seat after this record and all-green.
- Dev report deviations: assignee and review request not set at `pr_create` (accepted per SKILL.md); ESLint not run directly, covered by the derived lint families and the check-run (accepted, ①.11); `check:doc-formula-expressions` exit 3 on the first pass then 0 after building the two packages (reporting only). `open_questions` empty, `needs_decision: false`, `premise_still_valid: true`; the premise (the three residuals and the two wording gaps named in record 6520969324) reproduces on the base worktree in the probe's base column.
- The previous record's should-fix 4 asked for exactly the line-initial presence test this head ships; the loss that test carries (①.4) was not named there and is named here as should-fix 1 so the next card can weigh it with the measurement in hand.

### ④ Design judgment

Rules face, per `hits` file:

- contract-review.md :33. The 同形 line is where a seat reads what a record of record looks like, and the reader has required the line to sit below the heading since PR #28042; the edit says so in two characters inside the byte ceiling and the line ceiling, paying for them with one space, in the same word order `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` uses (BELOW the heading). Against the code it describes, the rule now matches the one reader every gate reaches the head through. Holds.
- The code half, read as the gate the rule names. Fence: testing the close before the open while a fence is open is the smallest change that makes "inside a fence" agree with CommonMark on a close with trailing text, and the open keeps its info string; the one residual divergence (a backtick inside a backtick-fence info string, F16) errs toward reading less, not more. Heading: refusing four spaces at the one place the scope opens, through a second two-token regex that also covers the blockquote, keeps the marker's tolerance for every presence reader and holds the heading to the same column-four bound as the key line; a code-indented record stays a record that names no head, which every consumer files as absent, and the writer refuses it. Writer: presence as a key LINE is the convention `keyLineRegex` already imposes on `Served-tier`, `Reviewed-by` and `Local-runs`, so the two keys this function judges now share one notion of "written"; the cost is the 16 shapes of ①.4, all loudness, all outside the template. The union with a key-then-hex-span limb would buy most of them back at the price of one prose false positive (P3), and that trade belongs to a card with the measurement, not to this one. No new gate, no new refusal class, consistent with triage. Holds, with should-fix 1.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-tk5mmg`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix (file on a follow-up card):
1. `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE` (post-stamped.mjs :2072) drops 16 reader-null shapes from the write-time refusal that base caught (①.4): a key line opening on a word (`Current Head-sha:`), two keys on one line with `Head-sha` second, a table row, underscore emphasis, a task-list item, a heading-styled key, a unicode bullet or emoji before the key, a bullet then a blockquote marker, strikethrough, parentheses, a no-break-space indent, an HTML comment. Loudness only, 0 live. Either add a second presence limb, the key followed directly by a 7-to-40 hex span anywhere on a line (which refuses a prose mention only when it carries the span, P3), or state in the docblock that a key behind a leading word or symbol is not a written key, so the next reader of the function knows the bound was chosen.
2. `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` (:2063) says `unindented` of the heading while the reader admits one to three spaces (H3), as the same sentence grants the key line; say `indented at most three spaces` for both, or `not indented as code` for the heading too. Cosmetic.
3. `FENCE_LINE` (:12698) opens a backtick fence whose info string contains a backtick (F16), which CommonMark does not; harmless here (it reads less, and a bare run still closes it), noted so the next tightening of the fence model has the list. Cosmetic.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：收紧契约复核记录 `Head-sha:` 行的读法，并让写入侧的报错更清楚。共 4 个文件。
  - 围栏：只在一行仅有同字符、长度不短于开栏的连续符号时才算关栏。像 ```` ``` 后面还跟文字 ```` 这样的行不再关栏。
  - 题头：缩进 4 格以上的 `## Contract review` 题头不再打开读取范围。
  - 写入侧：只在出现键行时，才判定记录里有 `Head-sha:`，正文中顺带提到这个键不再被拒。报错原因写明两种情况：缩进成代码的行、引用题头下的行。
  - 规则文本：`contract-review.md:33` 写明「题头之下」。
- 为什么改：这是 PR #28042 复核留下的 should-fix 4–8。前两项是读法上的残余边角，后几项是写入侧的报错精度。
- 风险与回滚：读法只收紧不放宽。用 11305 条评论（其中 713 条复核记录）对比基线：读法差异 0，拒收差异 0。写入侧放宽了一种情况：只是在正文里提到这个键的普通评论，不再被拒。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：先看 `check-half-states.mjs` 里关栏的判断，再看 `post-stamped.mjs` 的 `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE`。
- 两分钟验证：五个自测在本 head 上全部 exit 0：half-states 5113、recognisers 337、post-stamped 747、owed-reviews 65、guard 403。
- 需要你做的：无。登记册判定为 Tier S（`.claude/**` ×1）。契约复核 PASS，记录在本评论之前，`Head-sha: f619d317d724cc8dae9f673353ca2ddafa7831da`。本席转 ready 并开自动合并。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，没有 must-fix。复核构造了 78 种新写法，加上之前的 56 种和 31 种拒收写法，再加两个真实评论串，四个读者在新旧两边都做了对比：每一处变化都是从「读到被引用的 head」变成「读不出」或「读到作者自己那一行」，没有一处比基线更宽，四个读者每一行结论一致。

should-fix 1 是：写入侧不再拒收 16 种读者本来就读不出的写法，比如以普通单词开头的键行、表格行、行内第二个键。这些写法不会让任何 head 被误读成已审，线上 0 例，所以只是报错没那么及时，不是安全问题。它和 should-fix 2–3（措辞、CommonMark 信息串规则）一起转到跟进卡 #28111。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #28057`, four files: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (line 33, 120 bytes, which is the ceiling; line-neutral). `skip-changeset`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28103`: Tier S (`.claude/**` ×1).
- **前提实测:** the heading marker is byte-identical to base, so record presence in the locator, H43, owed-reviews, the guard and the writer is unchanged. An indented-heading record reads `stale` in owed-reviews and is refused by the writer, and that is pinned. Every reader still reaches the head through the one `contractReviewHeadSha`.
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `f619d317d724cc8dae9f673353ca2ddafa7831da`: 50 check-runs, 29 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 1 in progress (Test Core 1/8); auto-merge waits on it. Locally, the skill line ratchet, the skill-id lint and the token ratchet exit 0. The dev report shows 56 of 56 derived gate families exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`.
- **接受的偏差:** none. The write-side narrowing is what the card asked for (the #28042 record's should-fix 4). The shapes it no longer refuses are listed on #28111.
- **范围外去向:** #28111 (`pm:blocked` on this PR) takes review should-fixes 1–3.
- **落地条款:** Tier S. On the contract review PASS on the current head, the seat posts the record and this ACCEPT, flips the PR ready and arms auto-merge, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
